title: Cambridge interdisciplinary conference group photograph
description: The first Interdisciplinary Conference on Cognitive Science, Computational Modelling, and AI, organised and chaired by Di Fu at the University of Cambridge on 9-10 May 2025, brought together 120 attendees.
descriptionZh: 首届认知科学、计算建模与 AI 跨学科会议于2025年5月9日至10日在剑桥大学举行，由 Di Fu 组织并主持，共有120人参加。
